scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: npm run release && npm --prefix server start
scripts.render-build: NODE_ENV=development npm ci && cd server && NODE_ENV=development npm ci && cd ../client && NODE_ENV=development npm ci && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.release: npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run seed
